name: jtk
description: Fast Java formatter, compatible with palantir-java-format (same output, no JVM), and linter with fixes.

jtk.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `jtk` executable. If empty, the binary bundled with the extension is used, falling back to `jtk` on the `PATH`.

jtk.sortImports.description: Sort imports when formatting a whole document (unless jtk.toml switches it off).

jtk.removeUnusedImports.description: Remove unused imports when formatting a whole document.

jtk.reflowLongStrings.description: Reflow string literals that exceed the column limit.

jtk.formatJavadoc.description: Reflow javadoc comments (off by default, as in palantir-java-format).

jtk.unsafeFixes.markdownDescription: Also apply the unsafe fixes, which may change the behaviour in edge cases, in **Fix all jtk violations** (`source.fixAll.jtk`, for example on save).

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle-binary && vsce package
